Assistance & Policies

Contact & partnership FAQ.

What is the typical response turnaround for inquiries?

Our care team replies to general queries and documentation requests within 1–2 business days. Wholesale trade applications are reviewed by our partnerships desk within 3 business days.

What are the wholesale minimum order quantities (MOQ)?

Our opening boutique starter package begins at 25 mixed units across our tea, hair care, and therapeutic oil lines. Ongoing replenishment orders can be mixed across collections to suit seasonal retail demand.

Can I schedule an in-person dispensary walkthrough?

In-person visits to partner dispensary counters require appointment verification to ensure an Ayurvedic practitioner or care advisor is available to guide your consultation.

How can I request certificates of analysis (COAs) for specific batches?

Select "Certificate of Analysis Request" under the general inquiry form, and include the lot number stamped on the base of your packaging or carton.
